ksherkules.name: Hercules Monument
ksherkules.slogan: A copper giant watching over a mountain of waterfalls.
ksherkules.line: Possibly the most grandiose combination of landscape and architecture that the Baroque dared anywhere.
ksherkules.by: Georg Dehio, art historian, on Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe

ksschlosswilhelmshoehe.name: Schloss Wilhelmshöhe
ksschlosswilhelmshoehe.slogan: Rembrandt's faces, hung in a landgrave's neoclassical palace.
ksschlosswilhelmshoehe.line: After 1870 the defeated Napoleon III was lodged here for about half a year before going into exile in England.

kssababurg.name: Sababurg Castle
kssababurg.slogan: Roses climb the ruins where the Grimms' princess slept.
kssababurg.line: It was nothing but large, beautiful flowers that separated by themselves, allowing him to pass through without harm.
kssababurg.by: Brothers Grimm, Sleeping Beauty, tr. D. L. Ashliman

ksfridericianum.name: Fridericianum
ksfridericianum.slogan: Columns on Friedrichsplatz, and the stage of documenta.
ksfridericianum.line: Opened in 1779, it hosted the very first documenta in 1955, founded by Arnold Bode.

kssperrmauer.name: Edersee Dam
kssperrmauer.slogan: A 400-metre wall holding back a lake of drowned villages.
kssperrmauer.line: Opened in 1914, the dam was breached by RAF bouncing bombs on 17 May 1943 and rebuilt within months.
